outcome: risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) in women with severe pre-eclampsia (sPE)
cohort: 1953 women with severe pre-eclampsia (sPE) who delivered at the Women's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University between April 2015 and April 2023
finding: Twin pregnancy, placenta accreta spectrum disorders, and placenta previa were identified as independent risk factors for PPH in women with sPE.
mod_finding: Spinal anesthesia was associated with a reduced risk of PPH compared to general anesthesia in women with sPE undergoing caesarean delivery.
